name: greycollar
description: GreyCollar is a supervised agentic AI platform designed to automate tasks, manage workflows, and provide insights.
author: GreyCollar Team

scripts.predev: rm -rf dashboard/node_modules/.vite && cd ./mcp && npm run db:reset
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "main,api,dashboard,communication,event_listener" "npm start" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:communication" "npm run dev:inMemoryEventListener"
scripts.install: npm run install:api && npm run install:dashboard && npm run install:communication
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:dashboard
scripts.build: npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:api && npm run build:communication
scripts.docker:local:build: npm run build && npm run build:prod && docker compose -f local/docker-compose.local.yml build
scripts.docker:local: npm run docker:local:build && npm run docker:local:up
